explain: Seven professions (gathering, hunting, crafting, township, survival, chemistry, combat). Five branches each plus Master — 147 skills. Earn per-profession XP (xp-sources.csv), spend into SWG-style branch grids (rank costs 1/2/4/8 + Master 20). Independent of level skillPoints / PerksBook.

list.label: Gathering
list.blurb: Forestry, mining, salvage, permafrost, rift crystals — every node has a yield curve you can bend.

list.label: Hunting
list.blurb: Fishing, beasts, bounty contracts, trail-craft, traps. The wild and what it leaves behind.

list.label: Crafting
list.blurb: Equipment, blades, guns, armour, tinkering. Turn raw ore into a reason to keep going.

list.label: Township
list.blurb: Leadership, building, trade, diplomacy, defenses. A camp prosperous enough to outlast the rift.

list.label: Survival
list.blurb: Combat training, resolve, endurance, biome lore, veterancy. The half-second between a knockdown and a kill.

list.label: Chemistry
list.blurb: Cooking, potions, explosives, toxins, refining. Every brew, blast and meal that buys you another wave.

list.label: Combat
list.blurb: Pistols, rifles, blades, hammers, theft. The mastery profile of a working killer.

skills.name: Practiced Hand
skills.desc: +10% timber and branch yield from felled trees.

skills.name: Eye for Saplings
skills.desc: +20% chance for rare wood (oak_dark / sappling_pine); unlocks Forager hire (passive berry/herb gather in camp radius).

skills.name: Coppice Tender
skills.desc: Felled trees regrow 2× faster on the same tile.

skills.name: Moonleaf Druid
skills.desc: +25% herb_rare drops, herbs glow within 30m at night.

skills.name: Deepcore Sapper
skills.desc: +25% all metals, veins yield 2× when struck with rank-3+ pickaxe.

skills.name: Glacial Reader
skills.desc: Permafrost veins ping the minimap within 50m.

skills.name: Aurora Forager
skills.desc: +30% all tundra resources, unlocks aurora_crystal harvest.

skills.name: Shard Binder

skills.name: Riftcaller
skills.desc: +50% crystal yield, anomalies grant +1 rift_shard each.

skills.name: Scrap Magnet
skills.desc: +20% scrap from ruined chests and wrecks.

skills.name: Junker
skills.desc: Unlocks weapon → component recycling at workbench.

skills.name: Wreck Diver

master.name: Land's Bounty
master.desc: PROFESSION MASTER — +25% all yield, +25% rare drops, +15% speed, all branch unlocks active. Requires Forestry 4 + Mining 4 + Permafrost 4 + Crystals 4 + Salvage 4.

skills.name: Leviathan Lure
skills.desc: +30% first cast yield, unlocks leviathan-class catches.

skills.name: Big Game Hunter
skills.desc: +25% Hunting XP from boss beasts, +10% damage to all wildlife.

skills.name: Bounty Board Initiate
skills.desc: +1 active bounty contract slot. Unlocks animal contracts.

skills.name: Veteran Bounty
skills.desc: +1 active bounty slot (stacks), +10% bounty mission XP.

skills.name: Bounty King
skills.desc: +50% rare contract chance, +25% bounty mission XP. Unlocks villain NPC contracts.

skills.name: Bloodtrail

skills.name: Bird's Eye

skills.name: Pathfinder

skills.name: Passive Hunter

skills.name: Lure Crafter

skills.name: Mod Slot

skills.name: Hot Wire
skills.desc: Unlocks mid-tier attachment recipes; +10% gadget effect.

skills.name: Master Tinkerer
skills.desc: Gadgets crit for +50% effect; unlock prototype gadgets.

master.desc: PROFESSION MASTER — +15% all weapon damage, +25% craft quality, -15% craft cost, all unlocks active. Requires Equipment 4 + Bladesmith 4 + Gunsmith 4 + Armour 4 + Tinkering 4.

skills.name: Warlord
skills.desc: +5 NPC recruit cap, +20% morale, +2 party Follower slots (stacks).

skills.name: Salvage Yard
skills.desc: +10% morale per building; unlocks Logging Camp (employs Woodcutter NPC, +5 wood/day passive).

skills.name: Master Mason
skills.desc: -20% building cost (stacks); unlocks Mining Outpost (employs Miner NPC, +5 ore/day).

skills.name: Boomtown
skills.desc: -15% craft cost, +30% morale (stacks); unlocks Field (employs Farmer NPC, +5 herb/day).

skills.name: Haggler

skills.name: Caravan
skills.desc: Unlocks build_trade_post (passive 5 gold/day per post when staffed by Caravan Master).

skills.name: Black Market
skills.desc: Unlocks rare/contraband goods at township market stalls; unlocks Fence hire (buys stolen goods +50%).

skills.name: Tycoon
skills.desc: +50% gold from all sources, passive +10 gold/day per trade post; Bazaar slots gain 3 Vendor hire slots.

skills.name: Smooth Talker
skills.desc: Friendly NPCs heal you 1 hp/sec while in camp.

skills.name: Treaty Maker
skills.desc: Unlocks build_embassy (faction passive bonuses while built); unlocks Diplomat Envoy hire (mans embassy, +1 reputation/day).

skills.name: Crown Bearer
skills.desc: Friendly factions send a gift caravan weekly.

skills.name: Watchful
skills.desc: Unlocks build_watchtower; +25% camp NPC alert range; unlocks Sentry hire (mans watchtower, ranged alert).

skills.name: Sturdy Walls
skills.desc: Placed walls have +50% HP; unlocks Gate Guard hire pair (patrols gates/palisade).

skills.name: Auto-Turret
skills.desc: Unlocks build_turret_basic (auto-fires at hostiles in range); unlocks Turret Gunner hire (+30% accuracy / +20% rate while assigned).

skills.name: Fortress
skills.desc: +25% all camp building HP, turrets +50% damage; unlocks Captain hire (elite party companion + 3-NPC squad).

master.name: Lord of the Township
master.desc: PROFESSION MASTER — +3 recruits, +25% morale, -25% build cost, all unlocks active. Requires Leadership 4 + Buildings 4 + Trade 4 + Diplomacy 4 + Defenses 4.

skills.desc: Eat raw food without penalty; +10% all food yield consumed.

skills.name: Eternal Wanderer
skills.desc: Passive +1 hp/sec out of combat, +25% food duration (stacks).

skills.name: Element-Forged
skills.desc: +25% damage in any biome you have full resist for, biome resists stack.

master.desc: PROFESSION MASTER — +75 max HP, +25% DR, +25% stamina regen, +25% XP, all biome resists max, all unlocks active. Requires Training 4 + Resolve 4 + Endurance 4 + Wilderness 4 + Veterancy 4.

xpSources.trigger: timber_log node depleted
xpSources.notes: Wood drop.

xpSources.trigger: wild_herbs node depleted
xpSources.notes: Herbs feed potions and cooking — both live in chemistry.

xpSources.trigger: iron_ore node depleted
permafrost_ore node depleted
xpSources.notes: Tundra-only — highest gathering yield.

xpSources.trigger: copper_deposit node depleted
xpSources.notes: Desert-only.

xpSources.trigger: flint_outcrop node depleted
xpSources.notes: Cheap baseline.

xpSources.trigger: frozen_pond node depleted
xpSources.notes: Fish are also cooking input.

xpSources.trigger: any unhandled resource node
xpSources.notes: Default fallback.

xpSources.trigger: wildlife enemy death credited to player
xpSources.notes: Hunting > Animals branch flavor. baseHuntXp scales with creature tier; survival side-grant always positive.

xpSources.trigger: villain/raider death credited to player
xpSources.notes: Same routing as animals; doubled if target is on an active bounty contract (see below).

xpSources.trigger: bounty contract target killed/captured
xpSources.notes: Animal contracts unlocked by hunting.bounty.1. contractBaseXp scales with contract rarity.

xpSources.trigger: villain NPC contract completed
xpSources.notes: Villain contracts unlocked by hunting.bounty.4. 1.5× base XP and gold reward.

xpSources.trigger: enemy death + equipped weapon class = pistol
xpSources.notes: Combat XP gated on weapon class. Hunting still side-grants.

xpSources.trigger: enemy death + equipped weapon class = rifle
enemy death + equipped weapon class = blade
xpSources.notes: Sword/dagger/scythe.

xpSources.trigger: enemy death + equipped weapon class = hammer
xpSources.notes: Hammer/axe/blunt.

xpSources.trigger: successful pickpocket attempt (Theft 1+ required)
xpSources.notes: Unlocked by combat.theft.1.

xpSources.trigger: lock opened with picks
xpSources.notes: Speed bonus from combat.theft.2.

xpSources.trigger: stealth kill from behind (Theft 4+ required)
xpSources.notes: 1.5× multiplier; counts as kill for hunting side-grant.

xpSources.trigger: recipe id starts with 'build_'
xpSources.notes: Any building schematic.

xpSources.trigger: cook_* recipe completes
xpSources.notes: Currently routes cook_meat/cook_fish to chemistry — keep all cook_* on chemistry. boil_water/craft_bandage = medicinal (also chemistry).

xpSources.trigger: brew_* recipe completes
xpSources.notes: All brew_* recipes route to chemistry alongside cook_*.

xpSources.trigger: any other crafting recipe completes
xpSources.notes: Weapons / armour / tools / attachments.

xpSources.trigger: hire_* completes via successful dialog and the NPC settles into a tent in your claimed camp
xpSources.notes: NO GOLD COST. Recruitment requires: (1) dialog success per the Recruit Method in npc-hires.csv, (2) a placed claim_flag, (3) campfire + storage crate in camp, (4) one personal tent per NPC. First hire of each role grants +50% (×22 instead of 15).

xpSources.trigger: charisma/resolve/combat/survival check passes during recruit dialog
xpSources.notes: Granted whether or not the NPC actually joins (they may decline for other reasons). Side-grants 1 XP to whichever profession governed the check.

xpSources.activity: Place claim flag (first time per area)
xpSources.trigger: claim_flag placed in an unclaimed map sector
xpSources.notes: Stakes the area for recruitment. Subsequent flags in the same sector grant 0 XP (no farming). Also broadcasts your guild logo to nearby NPCs and to the world map. Will likely trigger a raid timer within 1-3 in-game days.

xpSources.trigger: raid resolved with claim_flag still standing
xpSources.notes: Per raid (not per ally — that's the separate Defend ally row). Caps at 1 grant per raid.

xpSources.trigger: faction pledge confirmed at Embassy
xpSources.notes: One-time grant per faction. Pledging unlocks faction contracts and turns the other four hostile.

xpSources.trigger: reputation crosses an upward threshold (Neutral→Friendly→Honored→Allied→Hero)
xpSources.notes: Grants once per tier per faction. See faction-reputation-tiers.csv for the full 8-tier scale. Maximum 4 positive tier-ups per faction = 100 XP/faction.

xpSources.trigger: reputation climbs back across a NEGATIVE threshold (Hated→Hostile→Unfriendly→Neutral)
xpSources.notes: Reward for digging out of a hostile state. Granted once per recovery; if you tank back into negative the second crossing grants nothing.

xpSources.trigger: faction-specific quest accepted at Embassy completes
xpSources.notes: Each faction has signature professions per factions.csv (e.g. Keepers route to combat or crafting/armour; Scavengers to crafting/gunsmith). Side-grant always township. Contracts only available at Friendly+ rep.

xpSources.activity: Defeat hostile-faction NPC in their territory
xpSources.trigger: kill an NPC of a Hostile or Hated faction inside their declared territory
xpSources.notes: Self-defense XP for the inevitable result of pledging — the two natural-enemy factions go Hostile and you'll fight them in their lands. Tagged so we don't double-count with the standard combat-kill XP.

xpSources.trigger: guild charter signed at Meeting Hall
xpSources.notes: Requires Diplomacy 2 + Meeting Hall built. Guild members share rep gains and a banner.

xpSources.trigger: 5+ ally NPCs settled in camp radius
xpSources.notes: Tribe unlocks shared cooking pot (passive food) and morale aura.

xpSources.trigger: 10+ ally NPCs settled in camp radius
xpSources.notes: Village unlocks Trade Post payouts and tier-2 building schematics.

xpSources.trigger: 20+ ally NPCs settled in camp radius
xpSources.notes: Town unlocks Bazaar slots tier-3 buildings and the Town Banner (faction reputation broadcast).

xpSources.trigger: allied NPC survives a raid in camp radius
xpSources.notes: Per ally per raid. Caps at 10 allies/raid to prevent farming.

xpSources.trigger: envoy returns from faction with positive outcome
xpSources.notes: Diplomat Envoy hire required; mission cooldown 1 in-game day.

xpSources.trigger: any NPC (ally or enemy) triggers a player-equivalent XP event
xpSources.notes: NPCs run the SAME XP table as the player at half rate by default. A Woodcutter chopping a tree gains gathering XP. A raider killing a hire gains combat XP. Each NPC tracks its own profession ranks and unlocks perks the same way the player does — visible on the NPC inspect panel.

xpSources.trigger: NPC crosses a profession rank threshold
xpSources.notes: Mirrors the player rank-up flow. NPC chooses a perk from the same tree the player would; allied NPCs use the perk in support of you raiders use it against you.

xpSources.trigger: player wields the Signature Item listed in professions.csv
xpSources.notes: Wielding a profession's signature item grants +25% XP for that profession's gain events. Currently scoped to Combat (per-branch weapon class) and Hunting (Bow/Sniper/Skinning Knife/Fishing Rod/Spyglass/Snare Kit). Other professions list signatures (Hatchet/Pickaxe/Ice Pickaxe/Resonator/Scrap Cutter/Hammer/Trowel/Coinpurse/Scroll/Turret Schematic/Pan/Pestle/Detonator/Vial/Tongs/Training Sword/Cloak/Pack/Medal) for flavor only.

spendRules.pool: Per-profession XP (independent of level skillPoints / PerksBook)
spendRules.spend: learnSkill spends cost from that profession pool; prereqs must already be learned
spendRules.costs: Rank 1=1 · 2=2 · 3=4 · 4=8 · Master=20 (95 XP to fully master one profession)
spendRules.bridge: GrudgeProgressionBridge.ts maps skills → abilities / craft XP routing
spendRules.ui: In-game: ProfessionsBook (C → Professions). Website: /professions interactive grid + XP sandbox.

note: 7 professions × 5 branches × 4 ranks + Master = 147 skills. Earn XP from activities (xp-sources.csv), spend into branch grids.
